The new subtable reader confines decoding to each subtable’s bytes. For each signed entry offset, `_readClassicSubstitutions` reads all glyph replacements from `max(0, ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset)` up to `min(numGlyphs, floor(size / 2) - offset)`, covering exactly the glyph words within both bounds for negative and positive offsets alike.
